A '''space mite''' was a type of [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]]-based [[Spider/Legends|arachnid]] that could reside in the vacuum of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Space mites spent their youth living on [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] as parasites. Once they reached maturity, the creatures detached from their hosts and would rapidly develop into their adult form, reaching about one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] in length. They would then spin hardened egg cases, into which they would lay up to a dozen eggs. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of space mites nested in the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system of the damaged [[3-Z light freighter]] [[Whisper (starship)|''Whisper'']], which was situated near to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korad]].
